name: Sengoku Koi Ittou
source:
In the sengoku era.
First mission of freshman ninja is…staying together with samurai!?

「This is mine.」

Masamune Date,Yukimura Sanada,and Ieyasu Tokugawa… I'm approached by these famous samurais!
The more I try to gather the information,the more I'm attracted to them.

What is the conclusion that you give as a woman as a ninja?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.otomedd.sgk.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在战国时代。
忍者新生的第一个任务是……和武士在一起！？

“这是我的。”

伊达政宗、真田幸村、德川家康……这些著名的武士都来接近我了！
我越努力收集信息，我就越被它们吸引。

作为一名女性忍者，你得出的结论是什么？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.otomedd.sgk.en]Google Play[/url]]
